messages:
holly: Heads-up: building a short, auditable flow for private deployments so customers get a verifiable isolation report. Main asks: tighten provisioner RBAC, enforce deny-by-default egress, require signed audit envelopes, and an explicit rollback path. Thoughts?

ben: Love it. Two constraints: keep prometheus scrape + fluentd egress for metrics/logs. Propose a small allowlist: kms-proxy, prometheus IP, log-forwarder. Anything else must be explicit.

omar: For RBAC, don't patch the existing ClusterRole in-place. Create provisioner-restricted and bind to the provisioner SA only in canary namespaces. Manifest example I'll use: 
```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: provisioner-restricted
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods","secrets"]
  verbs: ["get","list"]
```
Bind with ClusterRoleBinding scoped to canary.

chen: Vulnerability note: keystore-agent v1.4.0 has an unauthenticated metrics endpoint (CVE-2026-2001). Block until v1.4.2. We'll gate the canary with an image-scan + SBOM check.

holly: Good catch. Proposed rollout order: 1) CI image-scan & SBOM pass 2) deploy kms-proxy in control namespace 3) deploy provisioner-restricted binding in canary 4) apply deny-everywhere netpol with allows for kms-proxy, prometheus, log-forwarder 5) enable audit-signer (ephemeral wrap key) 6) run attestation verifier.

ben: Netpol pattern for canary (deny egress except kms-proxy + monitoring): 
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: canary-egress-restrict
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes: ["Egress"]
  egress:
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: kms-proxy
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.20.30.0/24 # prometheus/logs
```
We'll parameterize the CIDR per customer.

omar: Audit signing: two supported modes - customer-managed KMS (mTLS endpoint + allowlist) OR local HSM connector (bind localhost only). Signing flow: hash ndjson audit batch -> wrap with ephemeral wrap key -> sign with HSM/KMS -> store envelope in immutable object store. Ephemeral wrapping key TTL: 7 days. Publish fingerprint in the tenant attestation.

chen: Automation idea: run a post-rollout verifier job that checks (a) netpols present, (b) provisioner binding exists and has limited verbs, (c) signed audit batch verifies against published fingerprint, (d) synthetic egress attempt fails to a blocked host. If any fail, abort and trigger rollback.

holly: Rollback playbook: 1) remove ClusterRoleBinding for provisioner-restricted 2) delete canary netpols 3) revert keystore-agent image to previous version 4) revoke ephemeral wrap keys 5) collect evidence bundle and open incident if needed. Keep steps scripted for automation.

security-bot: Ticket SEC-2026-321 created: canary image gate + attestation verifier (owner: chen).

ben: Minor ops note - when we restrict RBAC, some controller webhooks might lose write perms. Include a preflight that runs a dry-run provisioning flow to catch missing verbs.

omar: Agree - add dry-run provision step in the pipeline and require success before full shard rollout.

holly: Scheduling canary for 21:30 UTC. Tagging @ben @omar @chen - please +1 if you can be oncall.

ben: +1

omar: +1

chen: +1, will own image-scan and the attestation verifier.

holly: Thanks. I'll add the manifests and a short evidence format to the private-deploy runbook and post the artifact link after the canary.
